Solomon swore a hundred women would each bear a knight for Allah's cause but did not say 'Allah willing', so only one bore a half-man; had he, all would have.
Not saying 'Allah willing', Solomon lay with ninety women hoping for horsemen in Allah's Cause, but one bore a half-formed child; the Prophet swore saying it would have brought them.
Solomon forgot to say 'If Allah will' when hoping ninety wives would bear warriors, so only one bore, a half-boy; had he said it, he would have got his wish.
Had Solomon said 'If Allah wills', each wife would have borne a horseman for Allah's Cause; the Prophet told a sick bedouin his fever purifies, if Allah wills.
The Prophet said they would camp at Khaif Bani Kinana tomorrow if Allah willed, and at the siege of Ta'if said they would return home tomorrow if Allah willed.
